definitions.startup_paint_proxy: Direct two native RAF callbacks after first POSED renderer.render CPU return; recorded uniformly on both sides. Not OS/GPU presentation timing.
definitions.cache: Fresh browser profiles, previously used machine/code. No cold driver/GPU cache guarantee.
definitions.render: Post-startup selection-cleared fixed-camera frames; 40 synchronous render+onepixel readback samples, then1s RAF.
definitions.memory: Overlapping RSS process trees, not unique memory or GPU VRAM; do not sum.

canvas.definition: Canvas equality required independently of full-image intended UI deltas. Full RGB difference PNGs and metrics retained without masking or forcing equality.
